newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner sees Q1 net exceeding estimates.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner sees Q1 net exceeding estimates.

text.p: Borg-Warner Automotive Inc chief executive John Fiedler said he expects first quarter earnings to exceed the Wall Street consensus of $0.86 per share by 15 percent, according to a company spokeswoman.
Fiedler, who spoke to a Morgan Stanley conference here on Tuesday, still expects full year results to be in line with the consensus view of $4.30-$4.40, according to the spokeswoman.
Fiedler said there was first quarter strength in sales and volumes across all product lines, especially in the light truck market.
Borg-Warner makes and markets components for automotive powertrain applications.
